children.label: Three more MATH courses numbered above 500 (9 hours)
children.source_text: At least three more MATH courses numbered above 500. 2 | 9 || 2 For this requirement, taking the three lab courses MATH 383L + MATH 528L + MATH 529L counts as one 500-level course.
notes: Interpretation: 'above 500' means 501 and higher; MATH 500 itself does not count.
Interpretation: courses numbered 700+ are graduate courses under UNC's numbering and are excluded.
Courses already used for another Math B.A. requirement (e.g. MATH 521, or MATH 577 when it fills linear algebra) cannot count again.
Individual 1-credit labs do not count; the three labs MATH 383L + 528L + 529L together count as one course (footnote 2).
600-level MATH courses count when completed or locked, but the planner only suggests 500-level electives.
Variable-credit, topics, and honors-research courses count when completed but are not auto-selected.
